a.lede: Amazon Web Services didn’t design its data centers to withstand war, and now the company admits it can’t recover what’s been lost.
a.title: Customer Data Permanently Lost in Iran Strikes on Amazon Data Centers

b.lede: Amazon Web Services' data centers in Abu Dhabi and Bahrain were struck by drone attacks more than six months ago. Now, the company has told customers to move their data to other regions, and it has no details on when repair work will be completed.
b.title: AWS tells clients to quit Middle East data centers six months after Iranian drone strikes — Amazon offers no recovery timeline as UAE mulls underground data centers [Updated]
